description: Offline-first TypeScript and Node.js toolkit for coding-agent repository readiness, context optimization, instruction validation, task workflows, policy checks, evidence and verification.
rules: Use the maintained guides and references for ACKit — AgentContextKit; archived task records and past release notes are historical evidence.
Preserve existing offline-first behavior; do not require network services, telemetry or untrusted plugins for the product runtime.
Do not treat generated verification results as valid without the documented evidence and freshness checks.
